sources.title: ESP32_AI_Connect - GitHub
sources.snippet: ESP32_AI_Connect is an Arduino library that enables seamless integration between ESP32 and leading AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic Claude, etc.). Designed for IoT projects, it provides a unified interface for AI-powered applications while optimizing for ESP32's memory constraints.
